title: Code on Wages source-readiness candidate
limitations: The Code, Central Rules and Ministry jurisdiction records reuse Wave 5A source identities; new commencement, corrigendum and notification-register records are source-identity snapshots rather than approved full controlled files.
State and Union Territory wage instruments, categories, zones, scheduled-employment mappings and rate notifications are not represented as selected or complete.
The candidate cannot choose the appropriate Government, a wage rate, wage category, zone, scheduled employment or State instrument.
The candidate cannot perform payroll, bonus, deduction, overtime, wage-period, entitlement, arrears or remedy arithmetic.
nextControlledAction: Acquire and fingerprint exact current Code, Central Rules, corrigendum and commencement files; select only the bounded State/UT and rate-source packs required for supported organisation routes; then obtain qualified legal, privacy, RAG, source-file, security and release approval.
